name: Audi R8 V10 2017 Vorsteiner
description:
The Audi R8 V10 Plus Vorsteiner is a tuned version of Audi's second-generation mid-engine supercar, featuring an aggressive Vorsteiner carbon fiber aerodynamic kit. The bodywork includes a redesigned front splitter, side skirts, rear diffuser, and rear wing, all crafted from lightweight carbon fiber.

Under the hood sits Audi's naturally aspirated 5.2L V10 engine, tuned to produce 630 horsepower and 560 Nm of torque. Power is sent to all four wheels through Audi's Quattro AWD system and a lightning-fast 7-speed S tronic dual-clutch transmission, enabling 0-100 km/h in just 3.2 seconds.

The combination of Audi's proven engineering and Vorsteiner's aerodynamic expertise creates a supercar that excels both on track and on the street, with enhanced downforce and an unmistakable aggressive presence.
author: VRSTNR
